name: rtk-hook
description: Codex plugin that transparently rewrites RTK-supported shell commands through a PreToolUse hook.

interface.longDescription: Ports Ghost233/rtk-hook into this marketplace. The hook delegates command detection to rtk rewrite, transparently applies RTK's supported rewrites, and leaves unsupported commands unchanged without blocking or asking the model to retry.
defaultPrompt: Use the RTK hook rules for shell commands.
